facts.fact: The report says the Cyber Security Authority sanctioned the Office of the Registrar of Companies on 12 August 2026 over non-compliance with requirements for critical information infrastructure institutions, so the ORC is treated as one.
The report states the Cyber Security Authority issued Tier One directives on 20 May and 15 June 2026 and imposed a sanction on 12 August 2026, so it exists and operates.

note: Sanctions are not incidents handled or alerts issued, so no response fact.
